resources.string: Create a recovery set

Recommend 2-of-3 with one offline medium. Select distinct physical storage domains and enter their stable holder IDs. Copies and app clones are the same holder. At most n−t losses are tolerated; t leaked pieces and the blob expose your original recovery inputs.

Choose two distinct local files before starting: incoming from the other endpoint and outgoing to it. Each explicit write replaces the outgoing file with the original signed object or HPKE transfer. Share them only by local media. Cloud providers and relay transport are forbidden. Leaving the app aborts the secret session.

This explicitly creates fresh recovery material for the selected holders. Prepared material is not active. All holders must persist and read back their package and a live threshold test must pass before activation. Root inputs remain only for this foreground operation.

Use a separate strong credential, preferably a randomly generated recovery code with at least 128 bits. Do not reuse the BIP39 passphrase or a device key, or store it beside the medium. A copied package allows offline guesses. Input is cleared on submission, cancellation and backgrounding; managed input may leave transient memory copies.

Select a trusted reader distinct from the collector. A reader that also holds another share may see two distinct pieces transiently. Clones and copies do not add independent holders. This release does not restore application ciphertext or prove that later set status is absent.

Collect only for the named operation shown above. Choose independent holders and a trusted separate reader for offline media. Each release requires live SAS and authentication. Root recovery restores no missing application ciphertext. No recovered mnemonic or passphrase is displayed or stored; cancellation/backgrounding ends temporary collection.
Explicitly start collection for this operation

Verify the intended chain, set and operation. Use the verified threshold only for this selected action. Disabling signs retired status and keeps public evidence; retained copies are not revoked. Epoch rotation requires current signed authority, policy consent, original receipts and CAS verification.
The selected operation completed and the native root session ended. Distribute any new signed public status to holders; this does not prove that every offline copy is current.
